about.title:
Revealing invisible infectious diseases
with uncompromising precision.
about.lead: MycoDx is an infectious-disease diagnostics startup founded by experts with extensive experience at the forefront of the biotechnology industry.
about.heroImageAlt: A researcher examining a Petri dish containing a microbial culture sample

intro.title: A biotechnology company setting a new standard in precision diagnostics
intro.paragraph1: MycoDx develops an integrated platform that connects culture, detection, drug resistance analysis, and image interpretation technologies for infectious disease diagnostics, supporting the full diagnostic process.
intro.paragraph2: Rather than stopping at individual testing technologies, we aim to build a faster and more reliable diagnostic environment through standardized and automated testing workflows.
intro.paragraph3: From the research laboratory to real clinical settings, we continuously advance diagnostic technologies that healthcare professionals and patients can trust.

camellia.title: Like the camellia, blooming vividly and resiliently through winter.
camellia.description: To accurately detect microscopic pathogens that are difficult to diagnose and impossible to see, we connect culture, detection, analysis, and image-interpretation technologies for the challenging diagnostic problems faced by healthcare professionals and patients.

mission.label: Why we exist
mission.title: Protecting patients through accuracy and trust.
mission.description: Effective treatment begins with an accurate diagnosis. Through uncompromising precision and objective clinical evidence, MycoDx establishes dependable diagnostic standards for healthcare settings worldwide and contributes to healthier lives.

vision.title: A healthier future that begins with accurate diagnosis
vision.statement: Toward global leadership in integrated infectious disease diagnostic platforms.
vision.description: By connecting culture-based diagnostics, molecular detection, drug resistance analysis, and intelligent imaging, we deliver faster and clearer answers wherever reliable diagnosis is needed.

validation.title: Technology Advancement & Validation
validation.description: We continuously improve the quality and reliability of our diagnostic technology through close joint research and clinical collaboration with leading medical and research institutions.

scalability.title: Integrated Platform Expansion
scalability.description: We continue to advance a platform that connects the full infectious disease diagnostic process and can adapt to diverse laboratory and clinical diagnostic workflows.

global.title: Global Market Expansion
global.description: Together with global industry partners, we will bring our diagnostic platform to markets worldwide and help eliminate gaps in access to healthcare.

home.description:
MycoDx develops an integrated diagnostic platform spanning detection, culture, and analysis for infectious diseases.
Built on microbial culture technology, we combine molecular detection, drug resistance analysis, and intelligent imaging for faster, more accurate infectious disease diagnosis.
